communications.text: Wanted you to hear it from me first — we closed our Series C this morning. The plan is to roughly double the training program over the next two quarters; you'll already have seen utilization climb from about 71% to 88% over the last four weeks as the new team ramps.

Quick question from our side: what reservation windows are available for additional H100 capacity in the same region? We're planning the next training cycle and want to understand lead times before we commit internally.
Can you send B200 availability and pricing for the reserved tier? We're modelling whether the next cluster should be on the newer silicon or stay on H100.

Noah joined the monthly review for the first time and stayed for the full session; he said the platform is now on the executive roadmap for the training buildout and asked to be included going forward.
We've been sustained above 90% on the reserved cluster for two weeks now and had to burst into on-demand twice — the team is starting to queue jobs.

communications.text: FYI utilization on our reservation went from 74% to 86% over the last three weeks as the new fine-tuning pipeline came online.
Is it possible to extend our reservation into a second availability zone? We'd like redundancy for the production inference path, ideally on the same commercial terms.

Oscar presented the internal results deck at their platform all-hands and credited the platform for the throughput gains; he shared the slides with us afterwards and offered to present them to other customers.
Utilization is up about nine points this quarter — the perception team moved their training runs over. No plans beyond that for now.
Routine monthly review with Mia: walked through the usage report and the roadmap; no expansion topics raised on either side.
We're scoping a pilot for a new recommendation model and might need a larger reservation for it — could you outline what a step-up to 32 GPUs would look like commercially?
Routine review with Wei: the recommendation-model pilot has been deferred to next fiscal year; current usage unchanged and no other topics.
